name: order_cbc_with_differential
description: Orders a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential white blood cell count. Evaluates red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin, hematocrit, platelets, and WBC subtypes (neutrophils, lymphocytes, monocytes, eosinophils, basophils).

when_to_use: Evaluation of infection or immune disorders
Monitoring chemotherapy effects on blood counts
